title: Orsen and the Cover
author: Orsen Whitlock
blurb: Kestrel Winterbourne, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
